### How it works

Four steps, so you always know where things stand.

#### Build

We talk, I plan the pages, and I build it around your colors, style and voice.

#### Launch

You check a private preview, then I connect your domain and go live.

#### Get found

I set it up so Google and AI tools like ChatGPT know what you do, and help with your Google Business Profile.

#### Ongoing care

Your monthly plan keeps it online, secure and current. Send changes anytime.

### Built right from the start

The basics a lot of websites skip.

- Mobile-first: Built for phones first.
- Fast loading: Pages open quickly.
- SEO for your type of business: Written around the services you offer.
- Ready for AI search: Marked up so Google and AI assistants can read it.
- Easy to get around: Simple menus. Nobody gets lost.
- Your brand, kept intact: Your logo and colors, used the way they're meant to look.
- Domain and DNS done properly: Your web address set up right, so it stays reachable.

# Pricing

URL: https://eaglewebcreation.com/pricing

Pricing

## Simple, upfront pricing

Website size is based on how far your business reaches. Pick the size that matches your customers. Every site also comes with a monthly plan that keeps it online, secure and up to date.

### Website creation

Priced by the number of pages on your site.

1–5 pages

$800

Best for: Local small businesses that work within about a 60-mile radius.

Ask about this: 1–5 page website

6–10 pages

$1,500

Best for: Larger businesses that advertise statewide.

Ask about this: 6–10 page website

10+ pages

By consultation

Best for: Multistate businesses and online stores (e-commerce).

How consultations work

#### Not sure which size you need?

Think about where your customers come from. That usually settles it.

- Customers mostly within about 60 miles: 1–5 pages, $800
- You advertise across the state: 6–10 pages, $1,500
- You sell in multiple states or online: 10+ pages, priced after a consultation

### Website management

Every site I build comes with a monthly plan. It keeps your site online, secure and backed up, and covers small changes along the way.

Starter

$75/mo

Required with every site: Keeps your site up and safe.

- Hosting and SSL certificate
- Regular backups
- Security updates
- Uptime checks
- 30 minutes of edits a month

Ask about this: Starter plan

Growth

$150/mo

Everything in Starter, plus: Help getting found and reviewed on Google.

- Google Business Profile upkeep
- Review requests sent to your customers

Ask about this: Growth plan

Local SEO

$275/mo

Everything in Growth, plus: Ongoing work to move you up in search.

- Monthly SEO work
- A monthly report on how your site is doing

Ask about this: Local SEO plan

Need more time in a month? Extra work is $100 per hour, billed in full hours. For example, an extra 40 minutes is billed as 1 hour.

What counts as website work? Things like updating your hours, prices, photos, or service descriptions, adding a seasonal announcement, or fixing anything that needs attention.

### Website consultation

Every 10+ page site starts with a consultation, and anyone can book one.

In a consultation we go over your business, the areas you serve, what you sell, and what your current website is or isn't doing for you. From there I'll recommend the right size of site and give you a price.

Good for: multistate businesses, online stores, and anyone who wants a second opinion before spending money on a website.

### Have a question about pricing?

Call or email and I'll help you figure out what fits.

# About

URL: https://eaglewebcreation.com/about

About

## About Eagle Web Creation

A small, local web design business in northern Wyoming, built on a simple idea: a business website should be clean, quick, and easy for customers to use.

### Who I am

I'm Talon Grant, and I build websites from northern Wyoming, often in the quiet hours after my newborn son finally falls asleep and before my wife, Saidey, tells me to close the laptop. When I'm not designing, you'll find me in the gym, battling it out on the pickleball court, chasing a basketball dunk I swear is coming any day now, or yelling at the TV during a big UFC card. Faith keeps me grounded, and Sunday mornings at church with my family are the part of the week I'd never trade. I bring that same mix of competitiveness and care to every site I build, because a small business deserves a website that works as hard as the people behind it.

When you work with me, you work with me directly. No sales team, no call center, and no handing your project off to someone you've never met.

### How I build websites

I build every site from scratch instead of using drag-and-drop page builders. Here's why that matters for you.

- It's faster: No extra builder code loading in the background, so pages open quickly, even on a weak cell signal.
- It's cleaner: Every page is laid out on purpose. Nothing on the screen that doesn't need to be there.
- It's built for search: Titles, descriptions and page structure are written around the services you offer and the area you serve.
- It's readable by AI: Your services, prices and service area are written out and marked up so AI assistants can describe your business accurately.
- It's set up properly: Your domain and DNS are configured correctly, so your site and web address work the way they should.

### What you can expect

#### Straight answers

Clear pricing up front, and an honest recommendation on what size of site you actually need.

#### Your brand, respected

Your logo, colors and voice stay yours. The site is built around them, not the other way around.

#### Easy for your customers

Simple menus, clear pages and contact info that's always one tap away.

### Let's talk about your website

See what each option costs, or reach out and tell me about your business.

# FAQ

URL: https://eaglewebcreation.com/faq

FAQ

## Common questions

Quick answers about pricing, the areas I work in, and how I build websites.

### Areas I serve

#### What areas does Eagle Web Creation serve?

I build websites for businesses across Wyoming's Big Horn Basin, including Lovell, Cody, Powell, Greybull, Basin, Worland and Thermopolis, along with smaller towns like Byron, Cowley, Deaver, Burlington, Manderson, Meeteetse and Ten Sleep. That covers Big Horn, Park, Washakie and Hot Springs counties.

#### Are you a local web designer?

Yes. I'm based in the Lovell and Cody area of the Big Horn Basin, and you work with me directly. No sales team and no project handed off to someone you've never met.

#### Do you work with businesses outside the Big Horn Basin?

Yes. Local businesses in the Basin usually fit a 1-5 page site, but I also build 6-10 page sites for businesses that advertise statewide and larger sites for multistate businesses and online stores.

#### Can you help my business show up when people search for my service in my town?

That's what I build for. When someone searches for something like a detailer in Cody, a hardware store in Lovell or a restaurant in Powell, your site should come up and answer their question. I write every site around the services you offer and the towns you actually serve.

### Pricing and services

#### How much does a website cost in the Big Horn Basin?

A 1-5 page website is $800 and fits local small businesses that work within about a 60-mile radius. A 6-10 page website is $1,500 and fits larger businesses that advertise statewide. Sites with more than 10 pages, like multistate businesses and online stores, are priced after a consultation.

#### What does website management cost?

Every site comes with a monthly plan. Starter is $75 a month and covers hosting, SSL, backups, security updates, uptime checks and 30 minutes of edits. Growth is $150 a month and adds Google Business Profile upkeep and review requests. Local SEO is $275 a month and adds monthly SEO work and a monthly report. Extra work beyond your plan is $100 per hour, billed in full hours.

#### When do I need a website consultation?

Every site with more than 10 pages starts with a consultation. Anyone can book one if you're not sure what size of site you need or want a second opinion on your current website.

### Search, AI and how sites are built

#### Will my website show up on Google?

Every site I build gets the search basics done right: page titles and descriptions written around your services and the towns you serve, clean page structure, business details marked up for search engines, and a properly set up domain. Nobody can honestly promise a #1 ranking, but your site will be set up to compete.

#### Can AI assistants like ChatGPT find my business?

AI assistants pull from websites they can read clearly. I build sites with your services, prices, service area and contact info written out in text and marked up with structured data, so search engines and AI tools can understand what you do and where.

#### Do you use Wix, Squarespace or WordPress?

No. Every site I build is custom-built, not made in a drag-and-drop page builder. That keeps pages fast and clean, without a page builder loading extra code in the background.

### Have a question that isn't here?

Pick a time to talk, or call or email anytime.

Schedule a call
